name: Skyphusion AI for Cloudflare
author: skyphusion

sections.description:
Skyphusion AI for Cloudflare is a free GPL plugin. Put Cloudflare® AI Search, Workers AI, and AI Gateway on your own Cloudflare account. Install from WordPress.org. Open Settings, then Skyphusion AI. Paste your public AI Search endpoint. You can set the same options with wp skyphusion-ai.

Why it exists: other plugins did not meet the need. The harness should not be a paid product of its own. You already have a Cloudflare account. You should put AI Search and agent calls on WordPress or WooCommerce without a second vendor fee.

The plugin fee is $0. It talks to Cloudflare services only. The plugin sends nothing to Skyphusion. Cloudflare free plans work. Past those plan limits, you pay Cloudflare. See the FAQ for the free-plan numbers.

What you get

Visitors get a search box. They can also open keyboard search with Ctrl+K or Command+K. You can turn on a chat button. The chat button is off until you turn it on.

WordPress and WooCommerce get a provider on the WordPress AI Client. The provider id is skyphusion-ai. It covers text, vision, JSON, tools, images, and speech. Open Settings, then Connectors. Save the API token there. This plugin does not store the token.

Set the account id on the Skyphusion AI screen. Add a gateway id only when Workers AI calls should go through AI Gateway. Leave it blank to call api.cloudflare.com. The screen links to Workers AI, AI Gateway, and AI Search.

One switch prints an AI Search answer above WordPress and WooCommerce search results. The switch is off until you turn it on. Errors stay off the page.

Optional tools stay off until you turn them on. Embeddings go into your Vectorize index. Related pages and member search use those vectors. A site assistant can answer from stored pages. An hourly job can fill empty alt text and empty SEO descriptions. Translation and internal-link suggestions are available. The plugin registers four read-only abilities for agents. See docs/search-ability.md. This plugin does not open an MCP server.

For a WooCommerce shop

A single product page prints its stock as text. Each variation names its attributes, its SKU, its price, and its stock. A simple product names its stock. The text sits in the page itself. A crawler that does not run JavaScript can index it.

The same page adds the SKU, the stock status, and the managed stock count to the meta description. Rank Math and Yoast both receive that sentence. The AI Search dropdown quotes it after the next crawl. A product that does not manage stock gets the SKU and the status, and no count. You do not add a custom field for this sentence.

You can also add a stock_quantity number field on the AI Search instance. That field is a filter. It is not what the dropdown prints. The steps, including Wrangler, are in the FAQ.

The assistant and the chat button do not add a product to the cart. Checkout stays a person.

Compared with other plugins

This plugin does three jobs, and it does not charge a license for any of them.

Search. The box is Cloudflare AI Search. The card shows the product image, the title, and the description. SearchWP, FiboSearch, Relevanssi, and YITH WooCommerce Ajax Search are keyword or instant search. They charge a license. They are not this search.

Chat. The chat button answers in a sentence from the index. The site assistant streams its answer. A product answer shows the image, the SKU, the stock status, and the managed count, and it links to the product. It is not a staff inbox. Tidio is a help desk. AIPCF is a free Cloudflare provider with its own site assistant.

Agents. Call Workers AI through the AI Client with using_provider( 'skyphusion-ai' ). You can expand those calls with Workers AI or with AI Gateway. This plugin does not edit posts by default. AI Engine Pro starts at a yearly license and you still pay the model vendor. Here the plugin fee is $0. Embeddings stay in Cloudflare Vectorize.

The tables, the renewal figures, and the page each price came from are in the Compared section of README.md. Every price was read on 2026-10-25 from that vendor’s own page.

Shortcode: [cloudflare_ai_search]

Example:

wp_ai_client_prompt( 'Write a product summary.' )->using_provider( 'skyphusion-ai' );

Other plugins can call cloudflare_ai_provider_embeddings() and skyphusion_ai_query(). cloudflare_ai_search_query() still calls the same helper. The search helper posts to the public chat/completions path. It does not send a token.

Cloudflare, the Cloudflare logo, and Cloudflare Workers are trademarks and/or registered trademarks of Cloudflare, Inc. in the United States and other jurisdictions. This plugin is an independent work. Cloudflare, Inc. does not sponsor or endorse it.

External services

This plugin connects to Cloudflare services. Each service is in the Cloudflare account of the site owner. The plugin does not connect to a service of the plugin author. Nothing is sent until you set the values that turn on that service. Cloudflare, Inc. provides all of these services.

  • Cloudflare terms of service: https://www.cloudflare.com/terms/
  • Cloudflare service-specific terms for Workers AI, AI Gateway, Vectorize and Workers: https://www.cloudflare.com/service-specific-terms-developer-platform/
  • Cloudflare privacy policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

Cloudflare AI Search

What it is: the search box, the keyboard search and the chat button. Host: your own instance on search.ai.cloudflare.com.

The plugin loads a JavaScript file from your own AI Search instance. Your browser runs that file. The file is search-snippet.es.js, pinned to snippet build 0.0.25. The plugin builds the address from the public endpoint you paste. It accepts only an https address on search.ai.cloudflare.com. It rejects any path, query, fragment or user information in that address. It checks the address again every time it reads the setting. The plugin loads no script until you paste an endpoint. It also loads none until you turn on the search box, keyboard search or chat.

What is sent and when: the visitor’s browser sends the search words or the chat question to the instance when the visitor searches or asks. The browser request also carries the visitor’s IP address and user agent, as every web request does. The site sends a test request to /search when an admin checks the connection. The site sends the search words to /chat/completions when the search-results answer is on and a visitor searches the site, and when another plugin calls the search helper. None of these requests send an API token.

Cloudflare Workers AI

What it is: the AI models that write, read images, make images, speak, translate and make embeddings. Host: api.cloudflare.com.

What is sent and when: the plugin sends a request only when a feature that you turned on needs a model, or when an admin or another plugin calls the AI Client with the provider skyphusion-ai. The request contains the prompt for that job. That can be a prompt from another plugin, a site assistant question and the stored passages that answer it, the post title and up to 6000 characters of post text for an empty SEO description, an image for empty alt text, text to translate, text to speak, or post passages for embeddings. The request also carries the account id and the API token. The plugin also reads the list of models on the account when it needs that list. It keeps the list for 12 hours. A failed read waits 10 minutes before the next try. That request sends the account id and the API token only.

Cloudflare AI Gateway

What it is: an optional proxy for the same Workers AI calls. It can log, cache and limit those calls. Host: gateway.ai.cloudflare.com.

What is sent and when: only when you save a gateway id. The same Workers AI requests then go to this host instead of api.cloudflare.com. Each request also sends a tag with the site, the feature, the model, the user id, and the tool. A visitor sends an empty user id. The tag does not contain the prompt. Prompts are logged only when you turn on logging in your gateway.

These Workers AI calls use this gateway when you save a gateway id.
The calls are the AI Client, the PHP assistant, embeddings, and backfill.
Translate, prompts, links, and insights use it too.
The assistant Worker uses it after you deploy that id.
A saved dynamic route sends text and chat calls on the chat path.
The model id is dynamic/ plus the route.
Image, speech, and embeddings stay on the model path.
The Worker does the same for its text calls.
Vectorize stays on the Vectorize binding.
AI Search does not use this gateway id.
Retry and timeout headers stay blank until you set them.
Image and speech do not send those headers until you opt in.
A refused gateway still uses the direct API for one hour.

Cloudflare Vectorize

What it is: the store for post embeddings. Related pages, member search and the site assistant read it. Host: api.cloudflare.com.

What is sent and when: only when embeddings are on. When a published post is saved, or when an admin runs the sync, the plugin sends that post’s vectors and this data for each passage: the post id, the post type, the title, the address, the terms, and for a product the image address, the SKU, the stock status and the stock count. A search by a signed-in member or by the site assistant sends the vector of the question. Each request carries the account id and the API token.

Cloudflare Workers

What it is: an optional assistant Worker that answers from the stored pages. Host: api.cloudflare.com for the deploy, and your own address on workers.dev for the Worker.

What is sent and when: only when an admin deploys the Worker from the settings screen or with WP-CLI. The deploy sends the Worker code, the site address, the model id, the index name and a shared secret. The deploy also sends the gateway id, the dynamic route, and the cache choice. After the deploy, the visitor’s browser sends the question and the earlier turns of that chat to the Worker. The Worker calls the site once each hour with the shared secret to ask for the next empty text. When the Worker address is saved, a member search also sends the search words to the Worker.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. In Cloudflare, turn on the public endpoint for your AI Search instance.
  3. In WordPress, open Settings, then Skyphusion AI. Paste that address.
  4. Paste the account id.
  5. Set the Workers AI API token. Prefer Settings, then Connectors, when that screen exists. Or set CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY.
sections.faq:
Where do I get the endpoint address?

Open the Cloudflare dashboard. Go to AI Search, then your instance, then Settings, then Public endpoint. Copy the address that ends in search.ai.cloudflare.com. The Skyphusion AI screen links there.

Where does the API token go?

Set CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY in the environment, or as a PHP constant. You can put the account id in front of the token as account-id:api-token. On WordPress 7.0 and later, Settings, then Connectors, is also available. WordPress passes that Connectors token to the skyphusion-ai provider through the AI Client. WordPress also reads the SKYPHUSION_AI_API_KEY environment variable or constant for that provider. The plugin does not read the Connectors option itself. The environment and the constant win over Connectors. This plugin’s own option never stores the token. The Skyphusion AI screen says which source is in use. It does not show the token. It does not link to Connectors when that screen is missing.

Do Cloudflare free plans work?

Yes. You need a Cloudflare account. The plugin fee is $0. Confirm the numbers on Cloudflare’s pricing pages before you budget. These figures match the 0.7.0 notes.

Workers AI: both Workers Free and Workers Paid include 10,000 neurons a day. The count resets at 00:00 UTC. On Workers Free, past 10,000 neurons the next Workers AI call fails until the next day. There is no overage price on Free. On Workers Paid, past 10,000 neurons you pay $0.011 per 1,000 neurons. Some models need a paid billing method even when neurons remain.

AI Search: each month an account includes 5 million ingestion tokens. It also includes 10 GB-month of storage. It includes 1,000 semantic queries and 1,000 full-text queries. Past those caps, Cloudflare bills its published rates. A small catalog can stay inside those four caps. That shop adds $0 of AI Search usage for crawl and search. The chat button and the search-results answer are generation. Generation spends Workers AI neurons. The public search box that only lists pages is not a PHP neuron call in this plugin.

Does the plugin stop at a neuron budget?

Yes. The default is 10,000 neurons a day. That matches the Cloudflare free allocation. Past it on Workers Paid, you pay Cloudflare. The plugin does not add a fee, and it does not send the site to another company. You can raise it under Settings, then Skyphusion AI. At that number, the next Workers AI call stays on the site until 00:00 UTC. You can instead send a plain text call to the cheapest priced model on the account. Backfill, embeddings, the site assistant, translation, vision, images, and speech still pause. Each tool can have its own daily limit. Zero means that tool has no limit of its own. Embeddings start at 3,000 neurons. The site assistant starts at 1,000 neurons, and that limit counts only while the assistant is on. A tool at its limit stops. The other tools continue. The screen shows today’s use for each tool. It warns when those limits, including the backfill limit while that job is on, add up to more than the daily budget. The totals do not store an IP address. The public search box and the chat button are not in the total and they are not in the tool limits. The plugin mails the site admin at 80% and at 100%. On a later UTC month it mails the previous month’s neurons and calls, once. That mail is the stored totals. It has no prompt and no IP address. A month with no stored use sends nothing. A repeated prompt is answered from memory for 10 minutes and costs no neurons. A regenerate asks again. The public search box is not cached. The cache key has no IP address. The AI Search rate limit is their cap. The admin bar says free next to 10000 when no budget is saved. After a call, an editor can see the feature, the model, the neurons, and the time. The receipt does not store an IP address.

Does AI Gateway see which feature ran?

Yes, when a gateway id is saved. Each Workers AI call sends the site, the feature, the model, the user id, and the tool. A visitor sends an empty user id. The prompt is not in that tag. A direct Workers AI call does not send the tag.

Does the search answer show its sources?

Yes. The search results page lists the pages under the sentence. A page with an address is a link. A page with no address stays as text. A failed search shows no sentence and no list.

Does a saved post get an embedding?

Press Count the posts on the settings screen to see passages, neurons, days, and stored dimensions before the first run. The count reads the posts in small steps, so a large store does not slow the screen. Run the sync there, or run wp skyphusion-ai embed run when embeddings are on. The sync goes in steps of 25 posts. WP-Cron runs the next step until the sync is done. A stopped sync starts again after the last post it did. A published post is stored in Cloudflare Vectorize. A post that did not change is not sent again. A password-protected post is left out. An editor can leave one post out. The embeddings daily limit does not stop the other tools. Deleting the plugin leaves the index in the Cloudflare account.

Can a member search the stored pages?

Yes. Place [skyphusion_ai_member_search] on a page. A signed-in member in a chosen role gets a list of pages. There is no generated answer. A logged-out visitor keeps the normal search and spends nothing. A repeated search is remembered for one hour. The same list can sit above the normal search for those members.

Do single posts show related pages?

The list uses the stored vectors. A page view does not call the model. The settings screen has a switch. You can also place [skyphusion_ai_related].

Does the site record searches?

The settings screen lists searches that found no page. The words stay in this site’s database. An IP address is not stored. A repeat from the same visitor within one hour is skipped. Rows older than 90 days are removed. An admin can ask once for a topic to write.

Can the site answer from its own pages?

The site assistant is off until you turn it on. You can deploy an assistant Worker from this screen, or with wp skyphusion-ai worker deploy. A blank address keeps the PHP call and streams the answer. The page does not show the token. A saved address streams from the Worker. The Worker finds the pages in one step. It asks the site each hour for the next empty text. The site writes that text. It answers from the stored pages and lists those pages. Signed-in people with one capability can ask. You can open it to every visitor instead. The chat button stays as it is. A saved chat needs the visitor to agree. An IP address is not stored. The assistant stops when the daily neuron budget is spent. It can also stop at its own daily limit. That limit does not stop the other tools. Zero means this job has no limit of its own. Place [skyphusion_ai_assistant] on a page.

Can empty alt text be filled?

An hourly job can fill empty alt text and an empty SEO description. It is off until you turn it on. It does not replace text you wrote. It writes the field used by Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO, or SEOPress. It stops when the daily neuron budget is spent. Each hour continues until the empty fields are done or today’s backfill limit is reached. That limit does not stop the other tools. The screen shows a skipped item and a retry. The SEO job sends the title and the page text. It skips a page with fewer than 40 characters of text. It cuts the text at 6000 characters. The alt text job reads the image. A decorative image is marked and the alt field stays empty.

Can a theme translate a string?

Yes. Call skyphusion_ai_translate() with the text and a language code. See docs/translate.md. The call stops when the daily neuron budget is spent. The error text does not include the API token.

Can the editor suggest internal links?

Yes. The post editor lists a page when its title is already in the post. It also lists a return link when this title is already a whole word in another published post or page. Neither page is changed. The same screen lists published posts and pages that nothing links to. It reads the pages 100 at a time, so a large store does not load every page in one request. Both lists show the newest pages first. The site keeps the result of the check for pages that nothing links to for one day. When a page, its address, or the list of pages changes, the next screen checks again. Outbound suggestions use the stored vectors. The editor does not call the model.

Can I edit the prompts?

Yes. Settings, then Skyphusion AI, lists each prompt this plugin sends. Reset restores one prompt. A test runs one call and shows the neuron cost. The empty text job, the site assistant, the link chat, and the search list use the saved text. The translation helper does not send its instruction.

Can I choose the model?

Yes. Settings, then Skyphusion AI, has a picker for writing, vision, image, speech, and embeddings. The plugin reads the models on your Cloudflare account and keeps that list for 12 hours. If the list cannot be read, the built-in models stay. An empty picker uses the built-in model for that job. A light model is optional. Titles, excerpts, meta descriptions, moderation, and alt wording use it when it is set. Leave it empty and the writing model stays in use. A model the editor already picked stays that model. The field does not fill in a model on its own.

Does the chat button cost extra?

This plugin does not charge a subscription. Cloudflare bills the account that owns the AI Search instance. The search box only lists pages. The chat button answers in a sentence and uses more of that allowance. You can leave the chat button off. The chat button is AI Search. It does not use this gateway id. The prices are in the Cost section of README.md.

Does search show how many are in stock?

Yes. The dropdown card shows the product image, the title, and the meta description. The image is the page image. You do not add a field for it. On a single product page the plugin adds the SKU, the stock status, and the managed stock count to that description. The card quotes the new description after the next crawl. A browser refresh does not start that crawl.

The search results page also prints the managed count under each product, for example “4 available.” A product that does not manage stock prints the status and no count. A variable product prints a count only when the parent manages stock. Variation counts are not added together. A negative count is not printed. Zero is printed.

How do I give AI Search the stock count?

The dropdown does not need a new field. It already quotes the meta description. Install this plugin. Turn on stock management in WooCommerce and save a quantity when you want a number. Then crawl the site again.

In the Cloudflare dashboard, open the instance and choose Sync index. With Wrangler, in the account that owns the instance:

npx wrangler ai-search jobs create your-instance

Replace your-instance with the instance name. The namespace defaults to default. Then list the job:

npx wrangler ai-search jobs list your-instance

The job is not instant. A new job can be started every 30 seconds.

The stock_quantity meta tag is a separate filter. AI Search ignores that tag until you add the field. You add it in the Cloudflare account that owns the instance. The plugin cannot add it. You do not add it for the dropdown.

  1. In WooCommerce, open the product. Turn on stock management. Enter the quantity. Save the product.
  2. In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to AI, then AI Search, then your instance.
  3. Open Parser options, then Custom metadata. These controls are in the instance settings.
  4. Add a field. Set the name to stock_quantity. Set the type to number. Keep every field you already have.
  5. Save. Cloudflare indexes the site again. This is not instant.

An instance allows five custom fields. This field uses one of them.

npx wrangler ai-search update does not set custom metadata. Do not use it to add this field. The create command does, and only for a new instance. Repeat every field you want to keep:

npx wrangler ai-search create your-instance --custom-metadata title:text --custom-metadata description:text --custom-metadata image:text --custom-metadata stock_quantity:number

Do not create a second instance to add this one field. On an instance you already have, use the dashboard or the API.

If you use the API, add {"field_name": "stock_quantity", "data_type": "number"} to custom_metadata with the fields you already have. Do not send that object as the only field. That removes the other fields.

The Wrangler commands are documented at https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/wrangler-commands/ . That page was updated on 2026-07-08.

Does this replace another AI provider?

No. A caller that wants this provider uses using_provider('skyphusion-ai'). You can expand those calls with Workers AI or with AI Gateway. The four agent tools sit next to WooCommerce in docs/agent-tools.md. The plugin registers four read-only abilities. See docs/search-ability.md.
sections.changelog:
0.7.1

  • Settings no longer links to Connectors when WordPress AI Client is absent. Set CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY instead.
  • WordPress.org assets include the ggc.sh screenshots.
  • Most PHPCS indent and spacing debt is cleared.

0.7.0

  • Upgrading, if you use embeddings: open Settings, then Skyphusion AI. A notice says the stored vectors lack the category and tag line. Press Count the posts to see the cost, then press Rebuild the index. Nothing is embedded again until you press it. wp skyphusion-ai embed rebuild does the same.
  • Upgrading, if you use the assistant Worker: deploy it again after you change the gateway. The Worker now sends its model calls through the saved gateway.
  • The site assistant sends chat calls through AI Gateway when a gateway id is saved. A saved dynamic route sets the chat model. Alt text stays on the vision model.
  • Gateway logs keep five fields and name the tool.
  • Retry and timeout settings for AI Gateway. A blank field sends no header. Image and speech stay off until you turn them on. The values are cut to fit the 30 second limit of the call. A timeout no longer starts the one hour on the direct API.
  • The Worker fills empty text when the gateway route answers in the chat shape. It no longer asks the model again for the same item every hour.
  • The embedding run works in small steps. The Run button does one step and WP-Cron does the next. --batch=N sets the size. A site with no WP-CLI can call POST /wp-json/skyphusion-ai/v1/embed/step.
  • Two steps never run at once, so one run is not billed twice. A step that finds another one running says so. A blocked run says it is blocked and how to resume it.
  • The settings screen counts the posts in small steps when you press Count the posts. It does not count on page load. Each admin has a count of their own. A count left for an hour is dropped.
  • Status, estimate, retry, reconcile, move and related refresh read the posts in batches. A retry stops at the daily embeddings limit.
  • The category and tag filter works for real posts and WooCommerce products. A product stores its categories and tags with its vector.
  • A block editor save now uses the new categories and tags. A post moved to an excluded category leaves the index.
  • A rebuild deletes the vectors of a post that is no longer included.
  • A site whose host sets up the Workers AI and Vectorize bindings uses them. Every other site keeps the REST API.
  • The editor link box reads the pages 100 at a time. It keeps the list of pages that nothing links to for one day.
  • The plugin registers four read-only abilities: search, related pages, member search and status. Related pages return an empty list for a private post, a password post, and an unknown post. A match the caller cannot read is left out.
  • The settings screen shows the gateway status. It keeps the saved gateway id while calls use the direct API for one hour.
  • wp skyphusion-ai smoke checks the WordPress AI Client locally. It sends no request to Cloudflare.
  • An optional llms.txt for crawlers. Unticking llms.txt in Settings turns the file off. It is served only at the home path and sends X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

0.6.3

  • The plugin gets the Workers AI token from the WordPress AI Client registry. It does not read the Connectors option.
  • The site assistant scripts load as enqueued files. The page has no inline script.
  • The streamed assistant answer uses the WordPress HTTP API.
  • The External services section names each Cloudflare service, the data it receives, when, and the Cloudflare terms and privacy links.
  • The readme no longer says an MCP server is planned.
  • The provider id is now skyphusion-ai. It was cloudflare. Another plugin also registers cloudflare. Call using_provider('skyphusion-ai').
  • Upgrading from 0.6.2 or earlier: open Settings, then Connectors, and save the token again under Skyphusion AI for Cloudflare. WordPress keeps each token under the provider id, so the old saved token is not used.

0.6.2

  • The search snippet version is the snippet pin, 0.0.25. It is not the plugin version.
  • The embedding form no longer uses a query parameter named exclude for a label. The saved value is unchanged.

0.6.1

  • The settings screen groups the same controls into panels. A short list of links sits at the top. No field was added.

0.6.0

  • The site assistant streams its answer when the Worker URL is blank. A saved Worker URL still streams.
  • A product answer shows the image, the SKU, the stock status, and the managed count, and it links to the product. It does not add the product to the cart.
  • The plugin registers one read-only search ability, skyphusion-ai/search. See docs/search-ability.md. The call sends no token.
  • The site assistant answers from stored pages. You choose who can ask. A saved chat needs consent. A chat longer than ten turns sends one summary of the older turns.
  • Posts can be stored in Vectorize as short passages. Related pages can say why they match. A signed-in member in a chosen role can search those pages.
  • An hourly job can fill empty alt text and an empty SEO description. One click applies the recommended defaults. Reset clears plugin settings and keeps text already stored on posts.
  • The activity log stores each Workers AI call, including a failed call. Site Health tests the connection and the Vectorize index.
  • English into the 22 Indian languages uses IndicTrans2. Every other pair uses M2M100.
  • The provider id stays cloudflare. The plugin fee stays $0.

0.5.3

  • The readme says license and color. The chat row says the site assistant streams its answer and cites the product. It does not add the product to the cart.
  • The plugin registers one read-only search ability, skyphusion-ai/search. See docs/search-ability.md. The call sends no token.
  • The plugin records four agent tools next to WooCommerce. See docs/agent-tools.md. This release does not open an MCP server.
  • The comparison says the dropdown already shows the product image, with the title and the description. The image is the page image. You do not add a field for it. The description still carries the SKU, the stock status, and the managed count.
  • The comparison says you can expand the chat button and the agent calls with Workers AI or with AI Gateway. An MCP server is planned. This release does not open one.

0.5.2

  • A single product page adds the SKU, the stock status, and the managed stock count to the meta description. The AI Search dropdown quotes that description. A product that does not manage stock gets no count. A variable product prints a count only when the parent manages stock. Variation counts are not added together. A negative count is not printed.
  • The readme says how to start the next crawl with Wrangler, and how to add the optional stock_quantity filter. The dropdown does not need that field. wrangler ai-search update does not set custom metadata.
  • The readme compares this plugin with search plugins, with Tidio for chat, and with AI Engine for agents. This plugin is the search box, the chat button, and the Cloudflare provider on the AI Client. It does not charge a licence for those.

0.5.1

  • The readme tells you how to add the stock_quantity field on your AI Search instance. You add that field in the Cloudflare account that owns the instance. The plugin already prints the meta tag. Nothing else changed.

0.5.0

  • Search results print the managed stock count on each product. The sentence is the same “N available.” line the product page already uses.
  • A product that does not manage stock prints no count. A negative count is not printed. A variable product prints a count only when the parent manages stock. Variation counts are not added together on the search card.
  • A single product page adds a stock_quantity meta tag. AI Search reads it only after the instance schema defines that number field. The search snippet still does not display the tag.

0.4.1

  • The plugin directory is now skyphusion-ai, matching the slug the plugin is submitted under. Earlier releases installed to cloudflare-ai-search.
  • Upgrading from 0.4.0 or earlier: install this release, then remove the old cloudflare-ai-search directory from disk. Do NOT use “Delete” in the plugins screen for the old copy, because that runs its uninstall routine and drops the saved settings. Settings live in the database and are not tied to the directory, so a disk removal keeps them.

0.4.0

  • Every shipped function is named skyphusion_ai_*. The old cloudflare_ai_* names keep working through shims, so existing snippets and child themes do not break.
  • Settings carry forward once on update, so a stored configuration survives the rename instead of reverting to defaults.
  • A rejected setting now says which submitted value was rejected and what was kept, instead of failing silently.
  • User-facing strings are translatable, and the translation surface is gated so an untranslated string is a test failure rather than a surprise.
  • wp skyphusion-ai accepts --accent-color; --color keeps working.
  • A variable product no longer reports its parent stock pool as a variation quantity.
  • Cloudflare trademark attribution and first-use designation, per Cloudflare’s published guidelines.

0.3.3

  • Grouped products print their children, so AI Search can index them.
  • An unknown product type prints a row for itself instead of nothing.
  • A malformed product no longer raises a PHP warning on every page view.

0.3.2

  • The search-results answer caps question length, caches answers, and limits calls per window.
  • A repeated question costs no model call and no worker time.
  • A failed or empty answer is cached for five minutes.

0.3.1

  • The plugin documentation uses Simplified Technical English.
  • No code changed in this release.

0.3.0

  • Product pages print variation and stock text as server-rendered HTML inside main, so AI Search can index it without browser rendering.
  • Each variation row names its attributes, its SKU when it has one, its price and its stock status. Out of stock rows are kept.
  • A negative stock count prints its status without the number.
  • The number of variation rows is capped. The filter cloudflare_ai_search_stock_max_variations changes the cap.
  • Development files are kept out of distributed archives by .distignore and by .gitattributes export-ignore.

0.2.2

  • The text domain is skyphusion-ai, matching the permalink to request. Saved settings stay on the same option.
  • Search snippet markup is escaped before it is printed. Workers AI error text is escaped before it is thrown.
  • A direct request for the WP-CLI file exits.

0.2.1

  • The plugin name is Skyphusion AI for Cloudflare. The author is Conrad Rockenhaus (skyphusion).
  • On a block theme, the search-results answer is inserted in the results block so it stays inside the document.
  • Direct requests for the endpoint and route files exit before they define anything.

0.2.0

  • Register a WordPress AI Client provider for Workers AI text, vision, images, and speech, through AI Gateway when a gateway id is set.
  • Link Workers AI, AI Gateway, AI Search, and Connectors from the settings screen.
  • Add embeddings and public AI Search helpers for WordPress and WooCommerce.
  • Optional AI Search answer above search results, off by default. The helper asks /chat/completions and reads chunks as sources. Search feeds and embeds do not print that answer.

0.1.0

  • Settings screen, WP-CLI command, search box, keyboard search, and optional chat button.

short_description: Workers AI, AI Gateway, and AI Search for WordPress and WooCommerce. Plugin fee is zero.
description:
Skyphusion AI for Cloudflare is a free GPL plugin. Put Cloudflare® AI Search, Workers AI, and AI Gateway on your own Cloudflare account. Install from WordPress.org. Open Settings, then Skyphusion AI. Paste your public AI Search endpoint. You can set the same options with wp skyphusion-ai.

Why it exists: other plugins did not meet the need. The harness should not be a paid product of its own. You already have a Cloudflare account. You should put AI Search and agent calls on WordPress or WooCommerce without a second vendor fee.

The plugin fee is $0. It talks to Cloudflare services only. The plugin sends nothing to Skyphusion. Cloudflare free plans work. Past those plan limits, you pay Cloudflare. See the FAQ for the free-plan numbers.

What you get

Visitors get a search box. They can also open keyboard search with Ctrl+K or Command+K. You can turn on a chat button. The chat button is off until you turn it on.

WordPress and WooCommerce get a provider on the WordPress AI Client. The provider id is skyphusion-ai. It covers text, vision, JSON, tools, images, and speech. Open Settings, then Connectors. Save the API token there. This plugin does not store the token.

Set the account id on the Skyphusion AI screen. Add a gateway id only when Workers AI calls should go through AI Gateway. Leave it blank to call api.cloudflare.com. The screen links to Workers AI, AI Gateway, and AI Search.

One switch prints an AI Search answer above WordPress and WooCommerce search results. The switch is off until you turn it on. Errors stay off the page.

Optional tools stay off until you turn them on. Embeddings go into your Vectorize index. Related pages and member search use those vectors. A site assistant can answer from stored pages. An hourly job can fill empty alt text and empty SEO descriptions. Translation and internal-link suggestions are available. The plugin registers four read-only abilities for agents. See docs/search-ability.md. This plugin does not open an MCP server.

For a WooCommerce shop

A single product page prints its stock as text. Each variation names its attributes, its SKU, its price, and its stock. A simple product names its stock. The text sits in the page itself. A crawler that does not run JavaScript can index it.

The same page adds the SKU, the stock status, and the managed stock count to the meta description. Rank Math and Yoast both receive that sentence. The AI Search dropdown quotes it after the next crawl. A product that does not manage stock gets the SKU and the status, and no count. You do not add a custom field for this sentence.

You can also add a stock_quantity number field on the AI Search instance. That field is a filter. It is not what the dropdown prints. The steps, including Wrangler, are in the FAQ.

The assistant and the chat button do not add a product to the cart. Checkout stays a person.

Compared with other plugins

This plugin does three jobs, and it does not charge a license for any of them.

Search. The box is Cloudflare AI Search. The card shows the product image, the title, and the description. SearchWP, FiboSearch, Relevanssi, and YITH WooCommerce Ajax Search are keyword or instant search. They charge a license. They are not this search.

Chat. The chat button answers in a sentence from the index. The site assistant streams its answer. A product answer shows the image, the SKU, the stock status, and the managed count, and it links to the product. It is not a staff inbox. Tidio is a help desk. AIPCF is a free Cloudflare provider with its own site assistant.

Agents. Call Workers AI through the AI Client with using_provider( 'skyphusion-ai' ). You can expand those calls with Workers AI or with AI Gateway. This plugin does not edit posts by default. AI Engine Pro starts at a yearly license and you still pay the model vendor. Here the plugin fee is $0. Embeddings stay in Cloudflare Vectorize.

The tables, the renewal figures, and the page each price came from are in the Compared section of README.md. Every price was read on 2026-10-25 from that vendor’s own page.

Shortcode: [cloudflare_ai_search]

Example:

wp_ai_client_prompt( 'Write a product summary.' )->using_provider( 'skyphusion-ai' );

Other plugins can call cloudflare_ai_provider_embeddings() and skyphusion_ai_query(). cloudflare_ai_search_query() still calls the same helper. The search helper posts to the public chat/completions path. It does not send a token.

Cloudflare, the Cloudflare logo, and Cloudflare Workers are trademarks and/or registered trademarks of Cloudflare, Inc. in the United States and other jurisdictions. This plugin is an independent work. Cloudflare, Inc. does not sponsor or endorse it.

External services

This plugin connects to Cloudflare services. Each service is in the Cloudflare account of the site owner. The plugin does not connect to a service of the plugin author. Nothing is sent until you set the values that turn on that service. Cloudflare, Inc. provides all of these services.

  • Cloudflare terms of service: https://www.cloudflare.com/terms/
  • Cloudflare service-specific terms for Workers AI, AI Gateway, Vectorize and Workers: https://www.cloudflare.com/service-specific-terms-developer-platform/
  • Cloudflare privacy policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

Cloudflare AI Search

What it is: the search box, the keyboard search and the chat button. Host: your own instance on search.ai.cloudflare.com.

The plugin loads a JavaScript file from your own AI Search instance. Your browser runs that file. The file is search-snippet.es.js, pinned to snippet build 0.0.25. The plugin builds the address from the public endpoint you paste. It accepts only an https address on search.ai.cloudflare.com. It rejects any path, query, fragment or user information in that address. It checks the address again every time it reads the setting. The plugin loads no script until you paste an endpoint. It also loads none until you turn on the search box, keyboard search or chat.

What is sent and when: the visitor’s browser sends the search words or the chat question to the instance when the visitor searches or asks. The browser request also carries the visitor’s IP address and user agent, as every web request does. The site sends a test request to /search when an admin checks the connection. The site sends the search words to /chat/completions when the search-results answer is on and a visitor searches the site, and when another plugin calls the search helper. None of these requests send an API token.

Cloudflare Workers AI

What it is: the AI models that write, read images, make images, speak, translate and make embeddings. Host: api.cloudflare.com.

What is sent and when: the plugin sends a request only when a feature that you turned on needs a model, or when an admin or another plugin calls the AI Client with the provider skyphusion-ai. The request contains the prompt for that job. That can be a prompt from another plugin, a site assistant question and the stored passages that answer it, the post title and up to 6000 characters of post text for an empty SEO description, an image for empty alt text, text to translate, text to speak, or post passages for embeddings. The request also carries the account id and the API token. The plugin also reads the list of models on the account when it needs that list. It keeps the list for 12 hours. A failed read waits 10 minutes before the next try. That request sends the account id and the API token only.

Cloudflare AI Gateway

What it is: an optional proxy for the same Workers AI calls. It can log, cache and limit those calls. Host: gateway.ai.cloudflare.com.

What is sent and when: only when you save a gateway id. The same Workers AI requests then go to this host instead of api.cloudflare.com. Each request also sends a tag with the site, the feature, the model, the user id, and the tool. A visitor sends an empty user id. The tag does not contain the prompt. Prompts are logged only when you turn on logging in your gateway.

These Workers AI calls use this gateway when you save a gateway id.
The calls are the AI Client, the PHP assistant, embeddings, and backfill.
Translate, prompts, links, and insights use it too.
The assistant Worker uses it after you deploy that id.
A saved dynamic route sends text and chat calls on the chat path.
The model id is dynamic/ plus the route.
Image, speech, and embeddings stay on the model path.
The Worker does the same for its text calls.
Vectorize stays on the Vectorize binding.
AI Search does not use this gateway id.
Retry and timeout headers stay blank until you set them.
Image and speech do not send those headers until you opt in.
A refused gateway still uses the direct API for one hour.

Cloudflare Vectorize

What it is: the store for post embeddings. Related pages, member search and the site assistant read it. Host: api.cloudflare.com.

What is sent and when: only when embeddings are on. When a published post is saved, or when an admin runs the sync, the plugin sends that post’s vectors and this data for each passage: the post id, the post type, the title, the address, the terms, and for a product the image address, the SKU, the stock status and the stock count. A search by a signed-in member or by the site assistant sends the vector of the question. Each request carries the account id and the API token.

Cloudflare Workers

What it is: an optional assistant Worker that answers from the stored pages. Host: api.cloudflare.com for the deploy, and your own address on workers.dev for the Worker.

What is sent and when: only when an admin deploys the Worker from the settings screen or with WP-CLI. The deploy sends the Worker code, the site address, the model id, the index name and a shared secret. The deploy also sends the gateway id, the dynamic route, and the cache choice. After the deploy, the visitor’s browser sends the question and the earlier turns of that chat to the Worker. The Worker calls the site once each hour with the shared secret to ask for the next empty text. When the Worker address is saved, a member search also sends the search words to the Worker.
